description: The 3DHD DevKit supplies Python tools to read, generate and visualize the 3DHD CityScenes road-map dataset. Its 3DHDNet pipeline provides training, inference and evaluation for map-deviation and three-dimensional object detection. The related source dataset contains globally referenced Hamburg road signs, lights, lane markings, temporary road features and LiDAR, giving this implementation a concrete infrastructure-map preparation and recognition role. The native description explicitly links the repository, whose current metadata identifies the same purpose. GitHub marks the repository archived and identifies the MIT licence. The public source is separate from the CC BY 4.0 dataset. No code, installation, model weights or performance benchmark was downloaded or executed. Source claims do not establish current maintenance, compatibility with every map encoding or detection reliability outside the documented dataset coverage.
interoperability: 3DHD CityScenes JSON map definitions and binary point-cloud tiles
